chiSiamo.titolo: I built what I was missing
chiSiamo.sommario: Prome is an independent project by Marius Trica, from Brescia, Italy. There is no company and no team: one person writes the code, reads the reports and decides what goes into the product.

motto.p1: It is not a marketing slogan: it is how I decide what to build. Every feature has to move someone forward in their studies, not keep them inside the app.
motto.p2: That is why there are no likes, no leaderboards and no invented notifications: only tools to study together, and an open door when you are done.

sostegno.p1: Prome is free for students and will stay that way. Today it has no revenue: the server, the domain and the time are mine, which is also why it grows slowly and without promises.
sostegno.p2: If it ever needs support, it will come from agreements with universities that want collaborative study tools for their courses. Never advertising, never selling data, never training models on your notes.

chiSiamo.bio: I write the code, read the reports and decide what goes into Prome. From Brescia, on my own, one piece at a time.

profilo.testo: First name, last name, university and course. Your university decides who sees what you write and which university-only rooms you can join: correcting it applies straight away. Rooms and groups you already created keep the university they were born with, and you are not removed from a room you are already in.

contenuti.testo: It covers the posts and comments you publish on the board, including the ones already written: what you choose here changes the past too, straight away. Materials in a study room follow the room's own rules, not this one.
contenuti.ateneo: Only people studying at your university
contenuti.pubblico: Every student signed up to Prome, never the open web

dati.testo: A copy of everything Prome holds about you: profile, posts, comments, groups, study rooms and the messages you wrote. It is a JSON file, readable by you and by another program. Links to the files you uploaded are valid for a limited time: if they expire, download the copy again.
dati.nonMiei: It contains no one else's data and none of your credentials.

impostazioni.esciDaTuttiSub: Also closes the sessions open on your other browsers and phones

elimina.testo: Your profile disappears immediately. Your posts and comments stay useful to those who study but become anonymous (“Removed user”), and personal data is deleted from backups too within 30 days. If you change your mind, you can reactivate the account within 14 days by signing in again.
elimina.introTitolo: Before you go, here's what happens
elimina.introTesto: No surprises: we explain it now, so you can decide calmly.

uno.testo: Name, university and course will no longer be visible to anyone.

due.testo: They stay useful to whoever is studying, but without your name: they will appear as “Removed user”.

tre.testo: Personal data disappears from backups too within 30 days. If you change your mind, you can reactivate the account within 14 days by signing in again.

elimina.alternativa: Was it something fixable? You can also turn off alerts, narrow who sees what you write, or block whoever is bothering you, without losing anything.

notifiche.stato: Notifications always wait for you here in the app, on the bell. These switches decide what interrupts you outside as well — email today, phone notifications once there is someone to deliver them.

commenti.testo: When someone comments on something you wrote. Never for your own comments. We also send you an email.

inviti.testo: When someone invites you to a study room or a group. The invitation email arrives regardless: it's how you accept.

pausaNotturna.testo: No alerts from 11:00 pm to 8:00 am

bloccati.testo: You no longer see each other’s content on the board, and their invitations send you no notifications. In rooms and groups you already share, leaving and moderation still apply.
